submission.prompt_text: Some people think that governments should spend money on improving public transport rather than building new roads. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
submission.essay_text:
Nowadays transport is very important problem in many country. Some people think goverment should spend money for public transport not for build new road. I am agree with this opinion in some way but not all.

Firstly, public transport is good for people. Because many people dont have car and they need bus and train to go work and school. If the bus is more better, people will use it more and the traffic will be less. In my city the bus is always late and very crowd so people dont like to take it. Also the train is too expensive for student. So goverment should make it cheap and more fast.

Secondly, new road is also important. Because the city is grow and more people buy car every year. If there is no new road the traffic jam will be very bad and people waste a lot of time. For example my father drive to work everyday and he spend two hour in the road. This is very bad for him and for the economy also.

But I think public transport is more important than road. Because the road make more car and more pollution. The public transport can carry many people in one time and it is good for enviroment. Also if more people take bus, the city will be more quiet and the air will be more clean, so everybody can be more healthy and happy.

In conclusion, I think goverment should spend more money for public transport but also build some road when it is necessary. Both is important for the people and the country develop.

criteria.label: Task Response
criteria.summary: 文章回应了题目双方：既说明公共交通对无车者和缓解拥堵的作用，也承认人口与汽车增长下道路建设有必要，结论给出‘公共交通优先、必要时修路’的保留立场，因此任务覆盖完整。主要不足是论证较浅，一些因果只下结论而缺少展开；开头立场也偏笼统，但后文已澄清。

strengths.quote: I think goverment should spend more money for public transport but also build some road when it is necessary.
strengths.comment: 结论清楚给出有保留的立场：公共交通优先，但必要时修路，与开头和主体一致。

strengths.quote: Because many people dont have car and they need bus and train to go work and school.
strengths.comment: 用无车者的出行需求说明公共交通的重要性，属于相关的因果支持。

strengths.quote: For example my father drive to work everyday and he spend two hour in the road.
strengths.comment: 用个人例子说明道路拥堵的时间成本，能支撑‘道路也重要’这一面。

issues.quote: I am agree with this opinion in some way but not all.
issues.comment: 开头只笼统说‘某种程度上同意，但并非全部’，没有说明同意到什么程度；虽然结论澄清了，但开头立场偏模糊。
issues.suggestion: 在引言直接写清立场，例如：I largely agree that governments should prioritise public transport, although new roads are still needed in some cases.

issues.quote: Because the road make more car and more pollution.
issues.comment: 把‘修路会导致更多汽车和污染’当作既定因果，缺少解释，论证显得跳跃。
issues.suggestion: 补充机制：new roads can encourage more private car use, which may increase congestion and emissions.

issues.quote: The public transport can carry many people in one time and it is good for enviroment.
issues.comment: 理由较概括，未说明为何运载量大就能减少污染或拥堵。
issues.suggestion: 展开为比较：one bus can replace dozens of cars, so emissions and road space per passenger are lower.

criteria.label: Coherence & Cohesion
criteria.summary: 五段结构清楚，先总说、分论公共交通、再论道路、回到公共交通、最后总结，整体推进可辨。衔接手段以 Firstly/Secondly/Also/So/Because 为主，较机械，且部分 because 引导的句子独立成句，句间关系不够顺畅。段落内部有时把多个小点并列，缺少指代和总结句，因此连贯性虽达标但不够精细。

strengths.quote: In conclusion, I think goverment should spend more money for public transport but also build some road when it is necessary.
strengths.comment: 结论回扣立场，使全文收束。

strengths.quote: Firstly, public transport is good for people.
strengths.comment: 用明显的段落主题句组织分论点，读者容易跟上结构。

issues.quote: Also if more people take bus, the city will be more quiet and the air will be more clean
issues.comment: 依赖 Also/and 串联，衔接单一，句内并列过长。
issues.suggestion: 拆成短句并使用更明确的连接，例如：If more people took the bus, traffic noise would fall. Air quality would also improve.

issues.quote: Because many people dont have car and they need bus and train to go work and school.
issues.comment: Because 从句独立成句，与前句逻辑关系没有被正确组织。
issues.suggestion: 把它并入主句：Many people do not own a car, so they depend on buses and trains for work and school.

criteria.label: Lexical Resource
criteria.summary: 词汇覆盖基本交通话题，如 public transport, traffic jam, pollution，能完成表达。但范围窄，重复多，拼写与词形错误频繁（goverment, enviroment, many country），比较级和搭配错误明显（more better, more fast），影响准确性和自然度，故为5.0。

strengths.quote: the traffic jam will be very bad and people waste a lot of time.
strengths.comment: 使用了 traffic jam, waste time 等话题相关表达，基本达意。

issues.comment: 可数名词单复数错误，many 后应用复数。

issues.quote: If the bus is more better
issues.comment: 比较级重复，more 与 better 不能连用。
issues.suggestion: 改为 If the bus is better。

issues.quote: make it cheap and more fast
issues.comment: 比较级和搭配错误，fast 的比较级是 faster。
issues.suggestion: 改为 make it cheaper and faster。

issues.comment: 拼写错误，goverment 应为 government；同类错误还有 enviroment。
issues.suggestion: 注意 government / environment 的拼写，写完后专门检查高频词。

criteria.label: Grammatical Range & Accuracy
criteria.summary: 能尝试 if 条件句、because 原因句等复杂结构，但正确率低。主谓一致、冠词、名词单复数、比较级和句子完整性错误频繁，如 my father drive... he spend two hour；部分 because 从句单独成句，标点与句法问题造成阅读障碍，故为5.0。

strengths.quote: If there is no new road the traffic jam will be very bad and people waste a lot of time.
strengths.comment: 尝试条件句和并列结构，能表达因果后果。

issues.quote: my father drive to work everyday and he spend two hour in the road
issues.comment: 主谓一致和名词单复数错误：father 后应用 drives，spend 应为 spends，two hour 应为 two hours。
issues.suggestion: 改为 my father drives to work every day and spends two hours on the road。

issues.quote: Because many people dont have car
issues.comment: Because 从句独立成句，且 car 前缺少冠词或复数。
issues.suggestion: 改为 Many people do not have a car, so...

issues.quote: Both is important for the people and the country develop.
issues.comment: Both 作主语应配复数动词；country develop 词性也有问题。
issues.suggestion: 改为 Both are important for the people and the country's development。

issues.quote: I am agree with this opinion
issues.comment: agree 是动词，不能用 be 动词加动词原形。
issues.suggestion: 改为 I agree with this opinion。

result.overall_comment: 这篇作文完成题目要求，结构清楚，能同时讨论公共交通和道路建设，并有保留立场。语言是主要短板：词汇范围窄，拼写、搭配、主谓一致和句子完整性错误频繁，衔接也偏机械。论证有个人例子和基本因果，但部分概括过强、展开不足。若想进一步提升，应优先修正基础语法和拼写，再练习把因果链写完整。
priorities: 先修正高频基础语法：主谓一致、可数名词单复数、冠词、比较级和句子完整性，确保 because/so 从句不单独成句。
建立拼写与搭配检查清单，重点纠正 government/environment、more better、more fast 等错误。
减少 Firstly/Secondly/Also/So 的机械串联，改用指代、同义替换和更明确的逻辑连接。
每个主体段把因果链写完整：先给原因，再解释机制，再用例子或比较说明结果。
引言直接说明同意程度，结论用同一立场收束，避免开头过于笼统。

position.quote: I am agree with this opinion in some way but not all.
position.comment: 立场是‘有保留的同意’：主要支持公共交通，但认为道路在必要时仍要建。P4 和结论与之一致，没有自相矛盾。

paragraphs.main_point: I am agree with this opinion in some way but not all.
paragraphs.comment: 引出话题并给出有保留的同意，但 in some way but not all 较笼统；功能仍是引言。

paragraphs.main_point: Firstly, public transport is good for people.
paragraphs.comment: 用无车者需求、公交晚点拥挤、票价贵等说明公共交通重要，论点相关且有支持。

paragraphs.main_point: Secondly, new road is also important.
paragraphs.comment: 作为让步或平衡段说明道路建设也重要，并用父亲通勤例子支持；这符合作者‘必要时修路’的限定立场，不是偏题。

paragraphs.main_point: But I think public transport is more important than road.
paragraphs.comment: 回到公共交通更重要的立场，用运载量、污染和健康说明理由，支持主旨。

paragraphs.main_point: In conclusion, I think goverment should spend more money for public transport but also build some road when it is necessary.
paragraphs.comment: 结论重申公共交通优先、必要时修路，与全文立场一致。

problems.label: 过度概括
problems.quote: so everybody can be more healthy and happy.
problems.comment: 这句话把公共交通改善直接推成‘每个人更健康快乐’，范围过大且缺少条件限定，使论证显得夸张。
problems.suggestion: 改为更谨慎的结果表述，例如 may improve public health and quality of life for many residents。

improvements.quote: I am agree with this opinion in some way but not all.
improvements.suggestion: 引言就明确立场程度，例如：I largely agree that public transport should receive more funding, though new roads remain necessary in some areas.

improvements.quote: In my city the bus is always late and very crowd so people dont like to take it.
improvements.suggestion: 把本地例子展开为‘问题—后果—政策’：班次不准和拥挤降低乘坐意愿，因此增加班次和补贴票价才可能改变出行选择。

improvements.quote: Both is important for the people and the country develop.
improvements.suggestion: 结论给出平衡标准，例如投资比例应取决于城市密度、现有拥堵程度和人口增长，而不是笼统说两者都重要。
